announcements.text: Jacobs Government Services Co., Arlington, Virginia, is awarded a $99,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for architect-engineer services. This contract provides for planning, design, and engineering services to support various project types throughout the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) Southeast area of responsibility and is expected to be completed by February 2031. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,000 will be obligated at time of award to satisfy the minimum guarantee. Additional funds will be obligated on task orders as they are issued. This contract was competitively procured via contract opportunities on SAM.gov, with 18 offers received. NAVFAC Southeast, Jacksonville, Florida, is the contracting activity (N69450-26-D-0013).

announcements.text: Rockwell Collins Inc., Cedar Rapids, Iowa, was awarded a cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price contract for acquisition of support services and incidental materials for the UH-60M Black Hawk Multi-Functional Display Avionics Suite. The amount of this action is $95,728,892. Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Feb. 24, 2031. Army Contracting Command – Redstone Arsenal is the contracting activity (W58RGZ-26-D-0027).

extracted.description: Acquisition of support services and incidental materials for UH-60M Black Hawk Multi-Functional Display Avionics Suite

announcements.text: The Boeing Co., St. Louis, Missouri, was awarded a not-to-exceed $61,548,900 undefinitized contract for the replenishment of GBU-57 Massive Ordnance Penetrator weapon system. This contract provides for Wing Drop Ship Kit sets, KMU-612 E/B Tailkits, GBU-57 G/B Fuze Systems cable guides, separation nuts, and Massive Ordnance Penetrator containers. Work will be performed at St. Louis, Missouri, and is expected to be completed between September 2028 and May 2030. This contract is a sole source acquisition. Fiscal 2025 procurement funds in the amount of $61,548,900 are being obligated at time of award. The Armament Directorate’s Attack Division, Eglin Air Force Base, Florida, is the contracting activity (FA8681-26-C-B001).

announcements.text: Top Aces Corp., Mesa, Arizona, was awarded a $33,193,783 firm-fixed-price contract for F-16 instructor pilot training. This contract provides for F-16 instructor pilot training that enables partner-nation pilots to achieve independent operational capability outside of the continental U.S. Work will be performed in Argentina and is expected to be completed by June 30, 2029. This contract involves Foreign Military Sales to Argentina. This contract was a directed source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 foreign military sale funds in the amount of $22,754,462 are being obligated at time of award. The 338th Contracting Squadron, Joint Base San Antonio-Randolph, Texas, is the contracting activity (FA300226C0003).

announcements.text: Sonalysts Inc., Waterford, Connecticut, was awarded a $16,193,981 modification (P00153) to a previously awarded contract (FA8806-19-C-0002) for operational test and training infrastructure capabilities follow-on. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $231,569,127 from $215,375,146. Work will be performed at Waterford, Connecticut, and is expected to be completed by Jan. 24, 2027. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds are being obligated at the time of award. System Delta 81, Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Karlas & Emmas Knits LLC,** Brooklyn, New York, has been awarded a maximum $30,564,450 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for various types of physical fitness shorts. This was a competitive acquisition with six responses received. This is a four-year contract with no option periods. The ordering period end date is Feb. 23, 2030. Using military services are Air Force and Space Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 through 2030 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE1C1-26-D-0031).
